extracted.intended_audience: prospective grantees, partners, and philanthropic stakeholders
extracted.subtask_description: Describes the Packard Foundation's vision, mission, programmatic priorities, values, and funding approaches that guide grantmaking decisions and partnership choices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Vision
rubrics_metrics.description: A just and equitable world where people and nature flourish.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Foundation-level aspirational goal that orients all program decisions and investment priorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mission
rubrics_metrics.description: We work with people and communities to create enduring solutions for just societies and a healthy, resilient natural world.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Overarching mission statement establishing that funding should partner with people and communities to achieve enduring, equitable solutions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Goal: Build just societies
rubrics_metrics.description: We support a strong civil society and inclusive institutions and governance to build just and equitable societies for all people.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Programmatic priority signaling support for civil society, inclusive institutions, and governance reforms that advance equity and justice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Goal: Protect and restore our natural world
rubrics_metrics.description: We champion bold climate solutions, an ocean that sustains us, and scientific innovation and discovery to secure the health and future of people and planet.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Programmatic priority emphasizing support for climate action, ocean health, and scientific innovation aimed at long-term planetary and human well‑being.

rubrics_metrics.name: Goal: Invest in families and communities
rubrics_metrics.description: We prioritize the importance of children having a healthy start and promoting resilient and vibrant communities where children and families thrive, so they have the power to shape their lives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Programmatic priority directing resources toward early childhood, family well‑being, and community resilience initiatives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Value: Belief in Individual Leadership
rubrics_metrics.description: We promote an environment of trust and flexibility, recognizing that people with diverse backgrounds, their ideas, and their efforts are at the center of change.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guides grantmaking toward supporting individual leaders and diverse perspectives; implies preference for flexible relationships and trust-based grants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Value: Effectiveness
rubrics_metrics.description: We strive for meaningful impact. We evaluate and adapt our work in partnership with communities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates emphasis on measurable, meaningful impact and adaptive, evaluative approaches developed with community partners.

rubrics_metrics.name: Value: Equity
rubrics_metrics.description: We strive for equity in all we do in pursuit of a more just world.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Signals that equity considerations should be central to strategy, selection of partners, and evaluation of outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Value: Integrity
rubrics_metrics.description: We are open and honest, hold ourselves accountable, and adhere to the highest standards of conduct and ethics in all we do.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Expectations for ethical behavior, transparency, and accountability from the Foundation and its partners.

rubrics_metrics.name: Value: Respect
rubrics_metrics.description: We show respect for all people. We value and listen deeply to diverse perspectives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implicates respectful engagement with communities and partners and valuing diverse viewpoints in decision‑making.

rubrics_metrics.name: Value: Thinking Big
rubrics_metrics.description: We encourage and support big ideas where a large, long-term commitment of resources can make a significant contribution to enduring change.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prefers bold, long‑term initiatives with potential for substantial, enduring impact; openness to risk-taking.

rubrics_metrics.name: Initiative: California Communities Initiative
rubrics_metrics.description: Promoting a Strong and Resilient California
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State-focused program priority; indicates geographic and thematic focus for relevant grants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Initiative: Children and Families Initiative
rubrics_metrics.description: Supporting Healthy Moms and Kids
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program priority centered on maternal and child health and related community supports.

rubrics_metrics.name: Initiative: Civil Society and Leadership Initiative
rubrics_metrics.description: Fostering a Thriving Civil Society
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focus on strengthening civil society organizations and leadership capacity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Initiative: Democracy, Rights, and Governance Initiative
rubrics_metrics.description: Advancing a Thriving, Resilient Democracy
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supports work related to democratic resilience, rights, and governance reforms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Initiative: Global Climate Initiative
rubrics_metrics.description: Ending Tropical Deforestation for People and Climate
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Global environmental program priority with a specific emphasis on tropical deforestation and climate outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Initiative: Global Reproductive Health Initiative
rubrics_metrics.description: Advancing Reproductive Health and Rights Globally
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Global health priority focused on reproductive health and rights.

rubrics_metrics.name: Initiative: Ocean Initiative
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensuring a Healthy Ocean for Nature and People
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program priority supporting ocean conservation and sustainable ocean systems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Initiative: U.S. Racial Justice Initiative
rubrics_metrics.description: Advancing Racial Justice in the U.S.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: National program priority focused on racial justice efforts within the United States.

rubrics_metrics.name: Initiative: U.S. Reproductive Health Initiative
rubrics_metrics.description: Advancing Reproductive Health and Rights in the U.S.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: U.S.-focused reproductive health and rights program priority.

rubrics_metrics.name: Institutional Commitment: Honoring long-term commitments
rubrics_metrics.description: Honoring long-term commitments to institutions that are core to our legacy
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates that the Foundation sustains long-term institutional relationships as part of its legacy and strategic practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program: Packard Fellowships for Science and Engineering
rubrics_metrics.description: Providing most promising early-career scientists and engineers flexible funding to take risks.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specific funding mechanism prioritizing early-career scientific/engineering leaders and flexible, risk-tolerant support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Strategy: Mission Investing
rubrics_metrics.description: Expanding the impact of our grantmaking through loans and equity investments
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates use of mission-aligned investing (loans, equity) as a complement to grants to extend impact.
